Only this test field is measured while it is focused. Reports stay on this device until you choose to export. This test does not change correction or learning settings.
Follow the full pinyin shown above, then select your text. Split commits may leave candidate metrics unavailable.

Select a candidate or finish the current pinyin before finishing this phrase.
The text is recorded as typed. Differences are measured, without silently correcting the result.
Compare runs made with the same phrases, keyboard size and typing habits.
A known target helps evaluate a phrase, but does not prove the intention behind every touch. Ambiguous, edited or incomplete samples are excluded from reliable key alignment.
-- means this run did not provide enough reliable evidence.
Suggestions marked * are measured separately from original candidates. A successful selection means the selection completed; target accuracy is checked against this phrase.
